text: In the two days since the last run (11 November), beauty (about +485 reviews), home & kitchen (+351), health & fitness (+348) and electronics (+332) moved most on Amazon, led by a OnePlus neckband (+55), Ghar Soaps bath bars (+55) and a ₹99 DesiDiya LED string light (+39), likely still post-Diwali reviews. For a beginner, crossbody and sling bags, simple toys and kitchen consumables like butter paper and air fryer liners look most reachable, because big brands lead almost everything else.

headline: Women's ethnic: kurta sets lead, silk and Kanjivaram-style sarees arrive
text: Kurta sets from GoSriKi and Klosia have the most reviews, and a ₹799 Klosia Anarkali set gained the most since the last run (+22), with a ₹999 Yashika chikankari set (+10) and a ₹779 GoSriKi set (+9) next; the category added about 150 reviews. Eight listings are new, mostly organza, Kanjivaram and pure silk-style sarees, and C J Enterprise Banarasi sarees around ₹500 to ₹550 are rising, which likely fits the wedding season. The typical price is about ₹747, and the top 10 products have about 11.3% 1-star reviews, the highest on Amazon. Sizes and complaints make this hard for a beginner.

headline: Women's western: very slow, New Year maxi dresses and embroidered tops
text: Amazon's own Symbol T-shirts have the most reviews, followed by Leriya Fashion dresses. Growth was very small, about 40 reviews in two days, with Shasmi and Preneum maxi dresses marketed for New Year parties (+6 and +4) gaining most. Embroidered Korean-style tops from Rieka around ₹645 to ₹695 keep rising, and ribbed tops, tank tops and Korean-style shirts are new to the list. The typical price is about ₹499, and the top 10 have about 9.1% 1-star reviews, so sizes and fit are a real risk.

headline: Men's clothing: Allen Solly and Van Heusen rule, jackets move
text: Big brands lead: Allen Solly and Van Heusen polo T-shirts and Amazon's Symbol polo have the most reviews. The category added about 160 reviews since the last run, led by a ₹748 Lymio hooded windcheater jacket (+23), the Allen Solly polo (+13) and a ₹495 Deemoon checked shirt (+13). Deemoon and Deelmo casual shirts at ₹495 are rising, and new listings include Peter England and Symbol shirts. The typical price is about ₹579 with about 9% 1-star reviews among the top 10; brands plus sizes make this hard for a beginner.

headline: Kids & toys: cheap card games and toy cars lead
text: Mattel's UNO card games (₹99 and ₹169) and a ₹157 Babique rattle ball have the most reviews. The category added about 180 reviews since the last run, led by a ₹399 set of 24 die-cast toy cars (+32), a ₹899 Lifelong kick scooter (+23) and UNO Show 'em No Mercy (+22). New listings are mostly girls' co-ord and winter sets from Hellcat, Goodwish and Tagas. The typical price is about ₹484 with about 8.6% 1-star reviews among the top 10. Unbranded toys like toy car sets have no sizes and suit a beginner, and Christmas gifting is about six weeks away.

headline: Home & kitchen: Pigeon and Milton lead, cheap lights and kitchen papers rise
text: Brands lead: a ₹189 Pigeon chopper (about 250,800 reviews) and Milton bottles are at the top, with Ajanta clocks close behind. The category added about 350 reviews since the last run, led by a ₹99 DesiDiya LED string light (+39), a ₹399 diya curtain light (+30) and a ₹259 kitchen scale (+24), likely still post-Diwali reviews. Rising newcomers include ₹149 butter paper and ₹289 air fryer paper liners, and new listings are mostly Milton bottles and lunch boxes. The typical price is about ₹259 with about 7.5% 1-star reviews among the top 10; small unbranded items like lights and kitchen papers are the beginner way in.

headline: Beauty: most growth on Amazon, all big brands
text: Dettol handwash, Vaseline lotion, Cetaphil face wash and Parachute lotion lead, all big brands. Beauty gained the most on Amazon, about 485 reviews since the last run, led by a ₹399 Ghar Soaps bath bar pack (+55), Cetaphil face wash (+43) and a ₹240 WishCare tinted lip balm (+27). New listings are brands such as L'Oreal, Pilgrim, Maybelline and Cetaphil, and winter moisturisers fit the season. The typical price is about ₹299 with only about 5.3% 1-star reviews among the top 10, but a beginner cannot easily compete with these brands.

headline: Jewellery: almost no movement on Amazon
text: YouBella bracelets, earrings and jewellery sets have the most reviews, followed by Shining Diva. The category barely moved, only about 11 reviews since the last run, with a ₹271 Shining Diva pearl necklace combo gaining most (+3). Only 32 products were read here, new listings include hair chains, crystal bracelets and frill necklace sets, and a ₹265 Rajasthani lac bangle set is rising. The typical price is about ₹295 with about 9.6% 1-star reviews among the top 10. Jewellery is light and needs no sizes, but Amazon demand looks much weaker than on Meesho.

headline: Bags & footwear: orthopedic slippers lead, crossbody bags rise
text: Doctor Extra Soft orthopedic slippers and flip-flops have the most reviews, with Lavie handbags and Asian sneakers next. Growth was slow, about 80 reviews since the last run, led by ₹599 Asian sneakers (+6), ₹598 Doctor Health slippers (+5) and Sparx shoes (+4). Rising newcomers are a ₹579 Walizza sling bag, a ₹479 Lyrovo crescent crossbody bag and a ₹649 Lavie wallet, while new listings are mostly orthopedic slippers. The typical price is about ₹579 with about 8.3% 1-star reviews among the top 10; bags have no sizes and suit a beginner better than footwear.

headline: Electronics: OnePlus, JBL and boAt rule; phone cases are the open door
text: Brand earphones lead: a OnePlus neckband, JBL and boAt wired earphones and realme buds. The category added about 330 reviews since the last run, led by the ₹1,910 OnePlus neckband (+55), OnePlus Nord Buds (+48) and Apple EarPods (+42). New listings are mostly phone back covers plus an Amazon Basics power bank, and a ₹312 Samsung A17 silicone case and Samsung chargers and cables are rising. The typical price is about ₹599 with about 9.6% 1-star reviews among the top 10; unbranded phone cases for new models are the realistic beginner option, not earphones.

headline: Health & fitness: brands lead, pull-up bars and lip care rise
text: Dettol handwash, a Havells hair dryer and a Philips straightener lead. The category added about 350 reviews since the last run, led by a ₹1,699 Philips trimmer (+29), a ₹240 WishCare lip balm (+27) and a ₹399 Be Bodywise roll-on (+18). A ₹549 Slovic pull-up bar is now #1 in its list, and lip balms and underarm care are new. The typical price is about ₹366 with the lowest complaint rate on Amazon, about 4.5% 1-star among the top 10; simple fitness gear is the beginner-friendly part.

Crossbody, sling and crescent bags around ₹450 to ₹600
Die-cast toy car sets and simple card games around ₹100 to ₹400 (Christmas gifting)
LED string and curtain lights around ₹100 to ₹400 (Christmas and New Year)
Butter paper and air fryer liners around ₹150 to ₹300
Phone back covers for new models around ₹250 to ₹350
Home pull-up bars and small fitness gear around ₹500 to ₹600

Avoid for now: earphones and neckbands (OnePlus, JBL and boAt dominate), branded beauty and personal care (Dettol, Cetaphil, Vaseline), branded men's polos, and size-heavy ethnic wear with over 11% 1-star reviews among the top 10.
